title: Chess But You Can't Go Offside
summary: Soccer-parody chess vs Martin: none of the player's pieces may go 'offside', i.e. closer to the enemy king than Martin's second-to-last defender. Frames include FIFA World Cup 2026 'OFFSIDE' broadcast clips.
rules: Standard chess vs Martin; player is White.

Offside rule (player only): a player piece may not move to a square closer to the enemy king's back rank/king than Martin's second-to-last defending piece or pawn (the offside line). Exact measurement approximate in the video (rules.jsonl) — implement as: rank distance from Black's back rank must not be less than that of Black's second-to-last unit (counting from Black's back rank, king excluded is inferred).
Normal check/checkmate; mates tend to be delivered from range.
